details.description:
Introducing New 3 Roses Elaichi. 3 Roses Elaichi Tea is crafted to elevate your tea experience—it delivers heavenly flavour through the richness of real, premium quality elaichi.
The blend is made with selected 3 Roses tea leaves from Assam that are known for brewing Perfect colour, taste, and strength in every cup. To this, crushed Elaichi is added sourced from high quality green cardamom pods that are prized for their sweet, floral aroma and cooling flavour.
Whether enjoyed with milk or plain, it brews into a fragrant cup that refreshes the senses and elevates your daily tea ritual. A perfect balance of strong tea and premium elaichi makes every cup truly indulgent.
To preserve this rich aroma, the blend comes in a specially designed Aroma Lock Jar. This jar keeps the elaichi freshness sealed in, ensuring every cup smells as pure and inviting as the first time you open it.
Elaichi is known as the queen of spices, treasured for its ability to make everyday tea feel special. Whether enjoyed on a rainy day, served to guests or sipped during quiet moments of unwinding, its warm and inviting fragrance will leave you feeling relaxed yet refreshed.
Try New 3 Roses Elaichi - The Perfect Colour, Taste and Strength of 3 Roses now with the heavenly flavour of real Elaichi.
